cases.title: Maya and the Firefly Forest

character.characterDescription: A cheerful six-year-old girl with voluminous curly dark hair
character.hair: voluminous, shoulder-length curly dark brown hair
character.defaultOutfit: yellow raincoat over a striped shirt, red rain boots

pages: Maya followed the glowing fireflies into the whispering forest, her red boots splashing through puddles that sparkled like stars.
Deep in the woods, a tiny owl with spectacles waved at Maya from a mossy branch and hooted a friendly hello.
Maya and the owl shared berries on a toadstool while the fireflies danced in loops above their heads.

cases.title: Maya's Moon Picnic

character.characterDescription: A cheerful six-year-old girl with voluminous curly dark hair
character.hair: voluminous, shoulder-length curly dark brown hair
character.defaultOutfit: silver space suit with an orange star patch

pages: Maya's cardboard rocket rumbled, wobbled, and then zoomed straight up past the clouds toward the big round moon.
On the moon, Maya bounced in giant slow-motion hops while a friendly alien family set out a picnic blanket.
Maya waved goodbye from her rocket window as Earth glowed blue and green below her.
